features.description: Exact variant key count (73), range (E1-E7), white/black pattern (43/30), and geometry
Six ordered sections at documented widths, 54/46 deck/keybed split, continuous chassis
Stable control IDs, per-section landmarks and density, Program/Synth as the only primary OLEDs
Pointer/touch/keyboard key press, release, and cancel/blur behavior
Every visible control moves or presses accessibly
Accessible names, roles, values, keyboard operation, and visible focus
Note on/off, repeated and overlapping notes, release, all-notes-off, node cleanup
Pointer, independent multi-touch, mapped keyboard with repeat suppression, MIDI note/velocity/sustain, and denied/disconnected MIDI
Sustain transitions, concurrent voices, deterministic stealing, velocity response, audible PCM verification
Truthful loading/ready/error/fallback status; blur/disconnect/unmount stops every owned voice
No marketing hero, detached rails, missing keys, overflow, or clipped chassis at 1440x900 and 390x844
Six selectable types; Grand/Upright/Electric are bundled recorded sample sets, audibly distinct, offline, with truthful provenance
Two-layer enable/focus/level/octave with correct voice ownership and cleanup
KB Touch, Dyn Comp, Timbre, Unison, Soft Release, String Res, Pitch Stick, and Master Level measurably alter rendered audio
Sustain from UI/keyboard/MIDI honoring SUSTPED toggle
Asset failure enters a labeled playable fallback without reporting the primary library ready
One AudioContext, per-layer buses, ordered effects, master gain/limiter, one destination, cleanup
Focus follows layers, manual focus, group and global modes, per-unit bypass, all-effects bypass, dry/wet, documented order, delay feedback path, To Rotary
Every unit and listed type measurably changes rendered audio
All Phase 1 tests remain present and green
Save/load restores all supported state across the 32 slots while excluding Master Level; dirty indicator is truthful
Store, Store As with naming, Program<->Live copy, and 8 auto-storing Live slots surviving reload
Edit-discard on program change, single-level Undo restoring prior edited state, and Exit cancel on Store/Store As
Program buttons 1-8, 4 pages, Program dial browsing, and numeric list view of all 32 programs
Enable, focus, level, octave, and effect-target routing for every layer of Organ, Piano, and Synth
Editable split points at all 11 documented positions (C2-C7), up to 4 zones, note routing, Off/±6/±12 crossfade gains
Wheel and Control Pedal (UI + MIDI CC11) assignment, positive/inverted interpolation, hardware indicators, and clearing
Layer Scene I/II toggles layer enable state without duplicating or losing sound parameters
Two-layer organ note lifecycle, levels, focus, zones, shared effect chain, and complete node cleanup
Audibly distinct B3/Vox/Farf/Pipe 1 (+ B3 Bass/Pipe 2), 9 drawbars/registers with LED state, B3 percussion, key click, V1-V3/C1-C3
Organ rotary routing, Slow/Fast/Stop with smooth acceleration, drive, and morphable speed
Three Synth layers, exact required waveforms (Pure, Sync, Multi, Super, FM-H) distinct per category, category-correct Osc Ctrl
LP12/LP24/HP/BP filters with tracking, resonance, drive, and Osc/Filter/Amp envelopes measurably alter rendered audio
Poly/Mono/Legato, note priority, glide, unison, vibrato, and 5-wave LFO with Master Clock sync alter voice behavior and audio
Deterministic Arpeggiator/Gate rate, Master Clock sync, range, direction (Up/Down/Up-Down/Random), KB Hold, and Arp Run
All engines share programs, scenes, zones, morphs, Master Clock, effects, one AudioContext, one master path, Transpose, and Panic
Every non-excluded control has canonical behavior and every spec-excluded control is explicitly listed as unsupported
All Phase 1 and Phase 2 tests remain present and green
